content: Key visual features: Split soybean stems showing bleached white interior with large black sclerotia (hard black bodies) embedded within. This strongly suggests White_Mold.

The test image shows split soybean stems with bleached white interior tissue and large, prominent **black sclerotia** embedded within. This is the hallmark diagnostic feature of White_Mold (*Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*):
- Bleached/white dried stems
- Large black hard sclerotia inside the stem cavity
- Matches description: "black sclerotia embedded within white fluffy mold on stems and inside stems" and "dry dead stems develop a bleached white appearance"

The SDS reference shows blue fungal growth on roots — clearly different. The Charcoal_Rot reference shows tiny microsclerotia (like charcoal dust), not large black bodies. White_Mold is the clear match.
